settlement.fee_treatment.english_name: Separate transaction expense or fee already included in quoted net settlement price
settlement.fee_treatment.meaning_zh: 交易费单列扣减或已经包含在合同净价中；不重复扣费

settlement.negative_price_treatment.english_name: Settle signed contract prices without inventing economic curtailment dispatch
settlement.negative_price_treatment.meaning_zh: 有合同和原始负价依据时按带符号单价结算，不擅自增加经济弃光策略

settlement.price_basis.english_name: Common nominal or real settlement prices without implicit inflation conversion

settlement.price_source.meaning_zh: 外售采用有效期价格表或同时间轴市场序列；不混用二者

settlement.price_year.english_name: Common price reference year consistent with original economic evidence

settlement.revenue_method.english_name: Owner avoided purchase, investor Power Purchase Agreement fixed or discounted settlement, or export-only revenue

settlement.tax_basis.english_name: Common tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive settlement basis without calculating tax payments
